headword: {画竜点睛|がりょうてんせい}

definitions.explanation: The crucial final touch that brings something to life or completes it perfectly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{画竜点睛|がりょうてんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: To add the finishing touch to this speech.

examples.japanese: {画竜点睛|がりょうてんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}く→欠く：13166_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To lack the finishing touch (to be incomplete).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{画竜点睛|がりょうてんせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Her performance was the crowning touch of the film.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{画竜|がりょう} (drawing a dragon) + {点睛|てんせい} (dotting the eyes)

ORIGIN:
From a Chinese legend about a painter who painted dragons on a temple wall. The dragons came to life and flew away only after he painted their eyes—demonstrating that the final detail brings the whole work to life.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {画竜点睛|がりょうてんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add the finishing touch
- {画竜点睛|がりょうてんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}く→欠く：13166_kaku⟧: to lack the finishing touch, to be almost but not quite complete

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary/formal; often used in writing or formal speech.
